prompt: Create an ultra-detailed anime fashion editorial portrait inspired by luxury streetwear, graphic pop art, and contemporary Japanese fashion illustration. Depict a stylish young woman with flawless porcelain skin, a short tousled jet-black bob, glossy metallic amber lips, and expressive golden-brown eyes partially visible behind oversized round yellow-tinted sunglasses. Dress her in an oversized black-and-white vertically striped button-up shirt, layered silver necklaces, a sleek black choker, and elegant geometric crystal earrings. Complete the look with a black-and-yellow striped baseball cap featuring artistic paint-splatter graphics. Pose her in a relaxed three-quarter close-up against a clean white background accented by bold yellow geometric panels and paint splashes. Use high-key studio lighting, premium cel shading, immaculate linework, graphic editorial composition, bold monochrome contrast with vivid yellow highlights, and ultra-detailed 8K illustration quality.

promptZh: 创作一张超精细的动漫时尚肖像，灵感源自奢华街头服饰、图形波普艺术和当代日本时尚插画。描绘一位 时尚年轻女性，拥有无瑕的瓷肌、凌乱的黑色短波波头、光泽感的金属琥珀色嘴唇，以及富有表现力的金棕色眼睛，透过超大号圆形黄色墨镜半遮面。为她穿上 一件超大号黑白竖条纹衬衫，搭配叠戴的银色项链、时髦的黑色颈圈以及优雅的几何水晶耳环。造型以一顶带有艺术感喷溅涂鸦的黑黄条纹棒球帽作为点缀。让她以放松的三分之二近景姿势呈现，背景为 干净的白色背景，点缀着醒目的黄色几何面板和油漆喷溅。采用高调摄影棚灯光、优质赛璐珞阴影、完美的线条、图形化编辑构图、鲜明的单色对比与生动的黄色高光，以及超精细的 8K 插画品质。
